title: LLM-Driven Discovery of High-Entropy Catalysts via Retrieval-Augmented Generation

contributions.purpose: 免微调用 LLM 发现高熵合金催化剂
contributions.mechanism: RAG 框架让 GPT-4 检索 50,000+ 材料库(MP+NOMAD+OC20,SciBERT 768 维+FAISS),两阶段检索 k=20 + 约束/类比/迭代提示工程
contributions.evaluation: 生成 250+ HEA,DFT 验证热力学稳定率 82%(无 RAG 仅 23%,3.6×);ANOVA F(3,796)=127.3
contributions.domain: 材料发现 / 电催化 OER
contributions.source_quote: First LLM-driven catalyst discovery without fine-tuning, generating 250+ novel HEAs with 82% thermodynamic stability validated by Density Functional Theory (DFT)

contributions.purpose: 宣称大幅提升筛选效率
contributions.mechanism: RAG+计算筛选取代传统高通量网格搜索
contributions.evaluation: 200× 资源缩减(4,200 vs 840,000 CPU-hours,for 10^6 组分)
contributions.source_quote: RAG-computational screening integration achieving 200× resource reduction versus traditional approaches

contributions.purpose: 宣称超越贵金属基线的活性
contributions.mechanism: DFT limiting potential 评估 + 火山图分析
contributions.evaluation: 最佳 Fe0.2Co0.2Ni0.2Ir0.1Ru0.3 达 0.285V(摘要称较 IrO2 提升 25%,贡献列表却写 15-20%,基线 IrO2 正文 320mV vs 表 0.380V,自相矛盾)
contributions.source_quote: 15-20% improvement in limiting potentials over IrO2 baselines, with best composition Fe0.2Co0.2Ni0.2Ir0.1Ru0.3 reaching 0.285V

contributions.mechanism: 分析 Fe-Co 相互作用对 *OH 结合的增强
contributions.evaluation: Fe-Co 协同较线性混合高 15%,30% 建议含新结构基元
contributions.source_quote: Discovery of synergistic Fe-Co interactions enhancing *OH binding beyond linear predictions.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We first demonstrate LLMs designing materials without fine-tuning via RAG, with our innovation being two-stage retrieval grounding abstract language in chemical constraints
Lewis et al. introduced RAG for NLP but materials applications remain unexplored.

notes: 自声明 4 条贡献。核心数据红旗(表格数字与正文矛盾):Table 1 top-5 催化剂 Band Gap 列为 2.1/1.9/2.3/1.8/2.0 eV(半导体/绝缘体),而摘要与正文反复宣称'metallic conductivity (band gap<0.1eV)'、'All top-5 LLM candidates maintain metallic conductivity (band gap ≤0.08 eV)'——表说 ~2 eV、文说 ≤0.08 eV,且基线 IrO2/RuO2 反而是 0.1/0.0 eV,方向完全颠倒,疑数据编造/未核对。数字不自洽:基线 IrO2 overpotential 正文 320mV、Table 1 记 0.380V;提升幅度摘要 25% vs 贡献列表 15-20%。全 LLM 生成+循环自证:方法数据由 GPT-4 生成,Claude Code 写全部代码,并用'custom AI writing agent'反复自评直至'passed review criteria evaluated by an LLM reviewer'(LLM 自审闭环)。纯计算/DFT 验证、无任何实验合成(自认'computational validation only','synthesis feasibility unaddressed';部分组分需 >2000°C)。负结果/trade-off(带数字):去 RAG 稳定率 82%→23%;analogy-only 提示仅 41% 稳定;activity-cost 权衡 Kendall τ=-0.42。AI Involvement checklist:AI-generated data=[Yes],人类校验仅靠 DFT。图 2-10 大量精确统计(Cohen's d 1.87/2.31/3.42、p<0.001、73%/78%/75%)由 AI 生成,占位图与雷同统计隐患。
